title: Dynamics 365 Business Central: AL Copilot Skills Collection (VS Code extension)
summary: The AL Copilot Skills Collection is a VS Code extension that installs AI coding assistant skills for Business Central AL development, supporting both GitHub Copilot and Claude. It includes purpose-built skills like a setup table generator that helps developers create tables and pages through conversational AI interactions.
key_points: Install multiple AI coding skills for AL development with a single command from the VS Code Marketplace
Skills deploy to your selected assistant target in the workspace and work with both GitHub Copilot and Claude
The setup table generator skill allows developers to create new setup tables and pages through conversational interaction
Works alongside AL Agent Tools to enhance the AL development experience

quotes.text: Install a collection of purpose-built AI coding assistant skills for Business Central AL development - with a single command.
quotes.why_it_matters: Explains the core value proposition: streamlined installation of multiple AI coding skills for AL developers
